key_insight: CFP AI is moving from isolated image models to a coordinated ecosystem where datasets, preprocessing, and multimodal models co-evolve toward more robust clinical intelligence.
clinical_relevance: For ophthalmology and broader screening workflows, this shift supports better disease detection, richer patient context, and more scalable deployment across diverse real-world settings.
method: Reviewed the evolution of CFP datasets from single-center labeled collections to multi-center, multimodal, and longitudinal resources.
Summarized preprocessing progress from classic enhancement to neural data engineering, token optimization, and EHR imputation.
Compared modeling trends from CNNs to foundation models, state space models, and multimodal expert architectures.
evidence_signal: The review synthesizes evidence across dataset, preprocessing, and modeling trends, highlighting a move toward multimodal CFP systems rather than reporting a single new benchmark result.
watch_item: Multimodal and edge-ready CFP systems may face implementation challenges from missing EHR data, domain shift, and uneven data quality across centers.
paper_title: Color Fundus Photography Analysis: Co-evolution of Data, Preprocessing, and Modeling toward Multimodal AI
